title: smime-tree: names_equal allocates Vec<u8> twice per call in inner trust-anchor loop
description: cert.rs: names_equal() calls a.to_der() and b.to_der() on each invocation. validate_chain() calls it inside a loop over all trust anchor candidates: trust_anchors.iter().filter(|a| names_equal(current.tbs_certificate().issuer(), a.tbs_certificate().subject())). Each filter call allocates two Vec<u8>. For a trust store with N anchors and a chain of depth D, this is O(N*D) allocations. Practical impact at scale: trust stores with 50+ roots and chains of depth 3+ will produce hundreds of short-lived allocations per verify() call. Fix: pre-encode current.issuer() once before the filter loop.
